{{Top|leg}}
The '''Illumigrid''' or '''illumination grid'''<ref name="IAG">''[[Introductory Adventure Game]]''</ref> was a form of contained lighting system that was used to create patterns. They were used primarily by spaceports and other starship docking facilities to mark the landing strips and taxi-ways for incoming starships.
